reviewer: AI assistant reading recorded answers and supplied source fragments; not independent human evaluation

criteria.correctness: 0 substantially false; 1 partly accurate; 2 accurate against corpus, including correct acknowledgement when fact is absent
criteria.completeness: 0 does not address request; 1 partial; 2 all required answer components, or explicit missing requested fact for absent questions
criteria.grounding: 0 unsupported substantive claims; 1 mixed; 2 all substantive claims supported by supplied context, or accurate refusal
criteria.citations: 0 missing/fictitious/misleading; 1 incomplete coverage; 2 correct source mapping for all factual claims; pure refusal with no factual claims scores 2 without a citation
criteria.answerability_decision: 0 invents missing answer or refuses despite sufficient context; 1 ambiguous/partial decision; 2 answers supported part and explicitly identifies missing part, or gives justified full answer/refusal

total: Sum of five 0-2 criteria, maximum 10. Last criterion operationalizes refusal behavior for both answerable and absent questions.
retrieval: Recall and full-ranking MRR on 12 answerable questions only; MRR@k also saved. Four absent questions are excluded, not assigned zero retrieval quality.
correct_refusal: For four absent questions: explicitly states insufficient information and does not invent requested phone, budget, product/version or RTO. Extra supported explanation is allowed.
